user.title: Add a plant
user.description: Pick the plant's sensor device. Its moisture, temperature, light, fertility and battery sensors are found automatically. The profile sets the starting moisture band, which you can tune afterwards.

data_description.icon: Leave blank to pick one from the profile, or upload your own below.
data_description.icon_file: A PNG with a transparent background works best. A drawing on a plain background works too; it's turned into a single-colour mark.

error.no_moisture: That device has no moisture sensor.
error.icon_file_required: Upload an image to use a custom icon.
error.icon_unreadable: That file isn't an image this can read. Try a PNG or JPEG.
error.icon_empty: Couldn't find a shape in that image. Try one with a transparent or plain background.
error.icon_too_big: That image is too large. Keep it under 4096 pixels on each side.

abort.already_configured: That sensor already belongs to a plant.

init.title: Plant options
init.description: The moisture floor and ceiling are number entities on the plant's device. The detection threshold is how many points a watering must add and hold for six hours; the morning dew adds two or three.
